title: NeuroSync BioBoot
text: The NeuroSync BioBoot replaces electronic sensors and mechanical actuators with a living, responsive interface: a layer of genetically engineered mechanoreceptor cells grown in a hydrogel matrix between the boot’s rigid outer sole and inner pressure bladder. title: Seismic Resonance Boot
text: The Seismic Resonance Boot uses a lattice of tunable phononic crystals embedded within the sole’s rigid insulation layer to selectively amplify and channel specific mechanical vibrations from the Martian surface directly into the footbed. title: Gravimetric Terrain Mirror

title: Plasma Touch Sole
text: The Plasma Touch Sole replaces traditional haptic feedback with a dynamic field of contained microplasma actuators embedded in a transparent, dielectric aerogel layer between the rigid outer sole and inner boot wall. title: Gravimetric Terrain Mirror
